text: If GroupHeader/InterbankSettlementDate is present, then CreditTransferTransactionInformation/InterbankSettlementDate is not allowed. If GroupHeader/InterbankSettlementDate is not present, then CreditTransferTransactionInformation/InterbankSettlementDate must be present.
reading: InterbankSettlementDate is in the GroupHeader or in every CreditTransferTransactionInformation, not both
